简介: April Mullen (/ˈmʊlən/) is a Canadian actress and filmmaker.[1][2][3] She directed Below Her Mouth in 2016, which was an official selection at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF).[4][5][6][7][8] She was one of several honorees of the Birks Diamond Tribute celebrating Canadian women in film during the 2016 TIFF,[9] and was interviewed about her film and that award on a morning news show in Toronto.[10] Canada's leading newspaper profiled her "female gaze" on the film.[11][12]
